title: I created a grand theft auto inspired game in Gemini 4 Neon
author: Apart_Potato959
selftext:
This took about 4 days in total on the Ultra plan. 5x usage. $80 a month. I didn't get close to using my 100% weekly usage, due to it being reset twice as I was creating this for some reason. Even if it wasn't reset, I reckon I'd be on about 15% usage left, as I was using about 15-20% a day, if that. The usage is crazy good.

I created this from scratch. I genuinely have no real idea of what i'm doing. I just type "now make her run look realistic lol"

I just kept doing this and building it up to see how much I could do. I cannot imagine what someone with actual gaming dev brains could do.

I've put this up online to play, but not sure if I'm allowed to promote it or not.

Anyway i enjoyed making this
